B2050.seeker_flawed_plan: Saskia plans to seal the finished chalk drawings by spraying them thoroughly with ordinary clear hairspray, believing it will act like a waterproof varnish and keep the art intact when toddlers step on or touch it.
B2050.flaw_explanation: Hairspray is formulated for hair and paper, not pavement; it goes on tacky, flakes off quickly, and offers little real protection against smudging on rough concrete. It also won't stand up to foot traffic, and spraying can even smear soft pastel before it sets.
